topic: An ice cube's last minutes in a glass of lemonade.

episode.title: If Things Could Talk: An Ice Cube’s Last Minutes

shots.narration: I'm trapped in lemonade, and my beach body is disappearing.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, clear lemonade glass on a cosy kitchen table, no lettering or logos.
shots.action: A square ice cube with big expressive eyes and a small worried mouth bobs in the lemonade.
shots.mood: Sunny yellow drink, sparkling highlights, comically alarmed expression.

shots.narration: They promised me a refreshing dip.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon kitchen, close view inside the clear lemonade glass.
shots.action: The square ice cube with big eyes and a small hopeful smile floats beside a lemon slice.
shots.mood: Cheerful lemon yellow, cool blue reflections, brief holiday-like calm.

shots.narration: [surprised] Nobody mentioned the complimentary full-body disappearance.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, lemonade surface inside a clear glass on the kitchen table.
shots.action: The ice cube with big startled eyes and a small round mouth melts into a visibly smaller, rounded shape.
shots.mood: Bright watery reflections, exaggerated wide-eyed disbelief.

shots.narration: Then someone installed a ceiling fan with no safety inspection.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, close view of lemonade with a plain curved straw.
shots.action: A stirring straw sweeps past the rounded ice cube with big nervous eyes and a small tense mouth.
shots.mood: Swirling yellow liquid, playful turbulence, looming straw.

shots.narration: I spent my afternoon doing laps I never agreed to.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon kitchen, clear lemonade glass viewed near its rim.
shots.action: The smaller ice cube with big dizzy eyes and a small crooked mouth circles through the lemonade.
shots.mood: Glossy circular ripples, comic dizziness, bright afternoon light.

shots.narration: [sighs] Great. Now my entire personality is rounded corners.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, close-up of the lemonade surface against a softly blurred kitchen.
shots.action: The shrinking ice cube with big drooping eyes and a small frown slowly rotates, revealing completely rounded edges.
shots.mood: Soft blue ice highlights, resigned expression, warm yellow surroundings.

shots.narration: They're drinking my bathwater. Somehow, I'm the uncomfortable one.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon kitchen, lemonade glass tilted beneath a partially visible human mouth.
shots.action: The tiny ice cube with big alarmed eyes and a small tight mouth slides toward the tilted glass rim.
shots.mood: Steep diagonal liquid surface, oversized glass rim, comic suspense.

shots.narration: At least nobody can say I didn't give this everything.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, upright glass with a shallow amount of lemonade and a plain curved straw.
shots.action: The tiny ice sliver with big tired eyes and a small brave smile melts into an even thinner sliver.
shots.mood: Warm afternoon glow, tiny sparkling ice remnant, mock-heroic dignity.

shots.narration: [chuckles] I'm almost gone; that straw's next on the chew menu.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon kitchen, close view of the glass rim, plain straw, and partially visible human teeth.
shots.action: Human teeth pinch the straw while the last ice sliver, with big amused eyes and a small smirk, remains visible below.
shots.mood: Comically flattened straw tip, knowing ice-cube expression, bright playful finis

episode.endHook: Next episode: the straw explains why every drink becomes a chew toy.
episode.description: An ice cube wanted a relaxing dip, not a disappearing act. Its final minutes in lemonade turn into a very personal meltdown—and the straw might have it worse.
